charts.title: TOI-4364 b: orbits around TOI-4364
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-4364's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-4364 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Distler et al. 2025 (2025AJ....169..166D), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname DISTLER_ET_AL__2025): P 5.424019 d

charts.title: TOI-4364 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-4364 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (5, 32, 98) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 4070275, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 8 minutes later to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 13 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 6-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 8 min late; 6-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 4 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
